The last person appointed to the U.S. Supreme Court is Associate Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson [d4, d5]. President Joe Biden nominated her on February 25, 2022, and the Senate confirmed her nomination on April 7, 2022 [d5]. She took her seat on the Court on June 30, 2022 [d4].
